Population pyramid, animated by year

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_pyramid.Rd

As in golemworldbank: the share of each five-year age group in the male population, to the left, and in the female population, to the right, animated over the years. The male values are drawn negative, so that the two sexes stand back to back, but the labels on the bars and the axis show them positive. The axis stays the same for all the years. The years whose figures jump back and forth from one year to the next, as Eurostat's for Greece from 1961 to 1969 do, are left out, and named at the top of the chart.

Usage

plot_pyramid(data, country)

Arguments

data

Data frame from get_pyramid().

country

Eurostat code of the country, for the title ("Country: " and its name, as in golemworldbank).

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

plot_pyramid(saved_pyramid("EL"), "EL")
